authors: Ohga, N., Ito, S. and Kolchinsky, A.
title: Thermodynamic Bound on the Asymmetry of Cross-Correlations
annotation: Equation (3) bounds short-time cross-correlation asymmetry by cycle affinity and length. Dropping affinity information gives the cotangent sector bound, applicable to Poisson potentials in the Green-Kubo realization argument.
